original_ai_output.title_zh: 几内亚反对派领袖阿利乌·巴获总统特赦出狱
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 几内亚反对派政治人物阿利乌·巴因侮辱军政府领导人马马迪·敦布亚将军被判入狱，在服刑近两年后于周五获得总统特赦。敦布亚为纪念几内亚独立日特赦了217名囚犯，巴为其中之一。人权组织和政治反对者指控几内亚军政府自2021年夺权以来不断收紧对异见的压制。

key_facts.fact: 几内亚反对派政治人物阿利乌·巴因侮辱军政府领导人敦布亚被判入狱近两年后获总统特赦
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Guinean opposition politician Aliou Bah, who was jailed for insulting junta leader General Mamadi Doumbouya, was granted a presidential pardon Friday after nearly two years behind bars.

key_facts.fact: 敦布亚为纪念几内亚独立日特赦217名囚犯，巴为其中之一
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Doumbouya granted pardons to 217 prisoners to mark Guinea's independence day, according to a presidential decree read on state television by presidency secretary-general Amara Camara. Bah was among those named.

key_facts.fact: 人权组织和政治反对者指控几内亚军政府自2021年夺权以来收紧对异见的压制
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: rights groups and political opponents have accused Guinea's military rulers of tightening their grip on dissent since seizing power in 2021

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
